ucs.title: [LLM] Akira ransomware shadow-copy wipe via PowerShell WMI (Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject)
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature pre-encryption recovery-inhibitor: deleting Volume Shadow Copies through the WMI/CIM pipeline rather than vssadmin. CISA AA24-109A and Sophos X-Ops both document this exact one-liner as the Akira/Howling Scorpius operator's preferred method, executed minutes before the Akira/Megazord encryptor runs.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","cmd.exe") AND Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*" AND (Processes.process="*Remove-WmiObject*" OR Processes.process="*Remove-CimInstance*" OR Processes.process="*.Delete()*" OR Processes.process="*Delete*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user="*$" NOT user IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Akira pre-encryption VSS nuke — WMI/CIM variant (not vssadmin)
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance",".Delete()","Delete")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Akira pre-encryption VSS nuke — WMI/CIM variant
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","cmd.exe")
| where CommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy"
| where CommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject","Remove-CimInstance",".Delete()","Delete")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware Shadow Copy Deletion via WMI/CIM
id: 7c2f1a91-3b6a-4d9a-9b1f-akira-vss-wipe-01
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira/Howling Scorpius pre-encryption recovery inhibitor that removes Volume Shadow Copies through the WMI/CIM pipeline rather than vssadmin.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/06/27/akira-ransomware-is-bringin-1988-back
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/31
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  selection_wmi:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
  selection_delete:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Remove-WmiObject'
      - 'Remove-CimInstance'
      - '.Delete()'
      - 'Delete'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_wmi and selection_delete and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Bespoke backup / cleanup scripts that intentionally cycle shadow copies
level: high
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g1024
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\cmd.exe) @CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *Win32_ShadowCopy*) @CommandLine:(*Remove-WmiObject* OR *Remove-CimInstance* OR *.Delete\(\)* OR *Delete*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wmic|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("Win32_Shadowcopy", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(Remove-WmiObject|Remove-CimInstance|\\.Delete\\(\\)|Delete)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Most ransomware crews call vssadmin.exe or wbadmin.exe; Akira operators specifically prefer the PowerShell WMI/CIM one-liner `Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject` (and its CIM variant), documented in CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, and Arctic Wolf reporting as the standard Akira/Howling Scorpius VSS-wipe. The class string `Win32_Shadowcopy` combined with a Remove-* verb is virtually never us

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira data-broker exfil: rclone/WinSCP/FileZilla pushing to MEGA / sync.com / pCloud
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's characteristic double-extortion staging step: SMB-collected loot pushed off-host via rclone (most common), WinSCP, FileZilla, or MEGAcmd to MEGA / sync.com / pCloud / Anonfiles within 24-72h of intrusion. The combination of these tools with these specific cloud destinations is an Akira/PUNK SPIDER fingerprint per Mandiant M-Trends and Arctic Wolf Labs Akira incident write-ups.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe","megacmd.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","megasync.exe","mega-cmd.exe") OR Processes.process="*rclone* copy*" OR Processes.process="*rclone* sync*" OR Processes.process="*rclone* move*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.io*" OR Processes.process="*pcloud*" OR Processes.process="*sync.com*" OR Processes.process="*anonfiles*" OR Processes.process="*transfer.sh*" OR Processes.process="*ufile.io*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user="*$" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Akira exfil: rclone / WinSCP / FileZilla / MEGAcmd → cloud storage
let ExfilTools = dynamic(["rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","megasync.exe","mega-cmd.exe"]);
let CloudTargets = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","pcloud.com","sync.com","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","ufile.io"]);
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (ExfilTools)
          or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone move","rclone lsd")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudTargets)
          or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","--config","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--max-age")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256;
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (ExfilTools)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (CloudTargets) or RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
union ProcHits, NetHits
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Akira exfil: rclone / WinSCP / FileZilla / MEGAcmd → cloud storage
let ExfilImages = dynamic(["rclone.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","filezilla.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","megasync.exe","mega-cmd.exe"]);
let CloudTargets = dynamic(["mega.nz","mega.co.nz","mega.io","pcloud.com","sync.com","anonfiles.com","transfer.sh","ufile.io"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ImgLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
| where ExfilImages has_any (split(strcat_array(ExfilImages, ","), ","))
      or ImgLower has_any (ExfilImages)
      or CommandLine has_any ("rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone move")
| where CommandLine has_any (CloudTargets)
      or CommandLine has_any ("mega:","--config","--transfers","--multi-thread-streams","--max-age")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware Cloud-Storage Exfil via rclone / WinSCP / MEGAcmd
id: 9a4d7e22-c1aa-4f44-bd5d-akira-exfil-mega-01
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira/PUNK SPIDER double-extortion staging — rclone, WinSCP, FileZilla, or MEGAcmd pushing collected data to MEGA / sync.com / pCloud / Anonfiles / transfer.sh.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
  - https://arcticwolf.com/resources/blog/conti-and-akira-chained-together/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/31
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_tool_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rclone.exe'
      - '\winscp.exe'
      - '\winscp.com'
      - '\filezilla.exe'
      - '\megacmd.exe'
      - '\MEGAcmdServer.exe'
      - '\megasync.exe'
      - '\mega-cmd.exe'
  selection_tool_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'rclone copy'
      - 'rclone sync'
      - 'rclone move'
  selection_destination:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.co.nz'
      - 'mega.io'
      - 'mega:'
      - 'pcloud.com'
      - 'sync.com'
      - 'anonfiles.com'
      - 'transfer.sh'
      - 'ufile.io'
      - '--transfers'
      - '--multi-thread-streams'
      - '--max-age'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_tool_img or selection_tool_cmd) and selection_destination and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - IT admins legitimately using rclone/WinSCP to sync data to sanctioned cloud storage
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.g1024
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\RClone.exe OR *\winscp.exe OR *\WinSCP.exe OR *\winscp.com OR *\filezilla.exe OR *\FileZilla.exe OR *\megacmd.exe OR *\MEGAcmd.exe OR *\MEGAcmdServer.exe OR *\megasync.exe OR *\MEGAsync.exe OR *\mega-cmd.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*"rclone copy"* OR *"rclone sync"* OR *"rclone move"*)) AND @CommandLine:(*mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *mega.io* OR *mega:* OR *pcloud.com* OR *sync.com* OR *anonfiles.com* OR *transfer.sh* OR *ufile.io* OR *--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *--max-age*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(rclone|winscp|filezilla|megacmd|megacmdserver|megasync|mega-cmd)\.(exe|com)$/i OR regex("rclone\\s+(copy|sync|move|lsd)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(mega\\.(nz|co\\.nz|io)|mega:|pcloud\\.com|sync\\.com|anonfiles\\.com|transfer\\.sh|ufile\\.io|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams|--max-age)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

ucs.rationale: Akira/PUNK SPIDER operators consistently pair their data-discovery stage (Advanced IP Scanner → SMB collection) with rclone-to-MEGA, WinSCP, or MEGAcmd exfil — the specific tool+destination pairing is documented in CISA AA24-109A, Arctic Wolf, and Mandiant M-Trends as a near-fingerprint for Akira intrusions. Legitimate admins do use rclone, so we lean on the cloud destination + rclone-flag combina
